G00_source.pass: All 560 files match pinned official archive; basis and evaluator hashes included.

G01_data.pass: No source hash/scene-group train-dev overlap; labels inherited; image paths/sizes valid; official test order unchanged.

G02_environment.pass: Server DCNv2 and grid sampler forward/backward finite; exact runtime/image digest and extension hashes recorded; all 4 GPU capabilities checked.

G03_module.pass: Equal capacity controls; full load lifecycle FPN max abs error <=1e-6; only adapter keys may be missing at official initialization; trained checkpoint reload exact.

G04_reproduction.pass: Official checkpoint, basis, full test and sweep protocol matched. Select the matching paper_targets.json profile only after checkpoint provenance is verified. Both Hmeans within 0.5 percentage point of that cited profile; otherwise investigate.

G05_probe.pass: 30 finite updates, 1-GPU then 4-GPU; no data-error resampling storm; nonzero adapter gradients/updates; save-reload; watchdog kill/reap fault test passes in container.

G06_pilot.pass: 500 updates each, same train/dev manifests, checkpoint initialization, optimizer, batch, LR, augmentations and seed; evaluate last checkpoint only on dev; no final-test selection.

G07_full.pass: Frozen candidate beats ordinary finetuning and capacity control; pre-registered dev target +1.0 pp mean glare e2e, clean loss <=0.5 pp, worst-severity loss <=0.5 pp; 3 seeds (42,43,44). Targets are research decisions, not measured outcomes.

G08_final.pass: Freeze configurations then run official full test/real heldout once per registered run. Report all seeds, raw metrics, mean/std, failure counts and source hashes; second dataset and matcher validated first.

G09_claim.pass: Ablations distinguish conditioning/location/capacity; real-data and second-architecture evidence before generality claims; unsupported hypotheses explicitly withdrawn.
